citations.desc: Cleaning, sanitization, housekeeping, and pest control.
citations.narrative:
An APHIS official observed frayed and flaking insulation material surrounding a metal pipe above a food preparation area
that is used for an eastern screech owl and barn owl. This insulation material may fall into food and water receptacles,
which could be ingested by the animals. The facility must ensure that premises where housing facilities are located are
kept in good repair in order to protect the birds from injury and disease. This was corrected by the facility at the time of the
inspection.
This is a 1st Re-License Inspection for a Class “C” license. The inspection and exit briefing were conducted with the
applicant.
All items must be in compliance within 2 more inspections or by September 21, 2026, or the applicant will forfeit the
license fee and must wait 6 months to reapply. Please contact your inspector to schedule your next Re-License
Inspection.
Regulated activity can continue under your existing USDA license until it expires.
Additional Inspectors:
Tonya Hadjis, Supervisory Animal Care Specialist n
